module_summary: Serial-to-parallel converter accumulating 8 bits of serial input using shift register and counter, outputting 8-bit parallel word with valid pulse.

anchors.name: cnt
anchors.why: Bit counter tracking serial input accumulation; triggers output valid at 8

anchors.name: din_tmp
anchors.why: 8-bit shift register accumulating serial input bits into parallel word

anchors.name: din_serial
anchors.why: Serial input data bit; shifted into accumulator on each valid pulse

anchors.name: din_valid
anchors.why: Input valid signal; gates serial input shifting and counter increment

anchors.name: dout_parallel
anchors.why: 8-bit parallel output carrying accumulated serial bits when valid

anchors.name: dout_valid
anchors.why: Output valid pulse; asserted when 8 bits accumulated (cnt == 8)

groups.name: Serial_Accumulator
groups.description: Shift register and counter accumulating 8 serial bits

groups.name: Input_Interface
groups.description: Serial input data and valid control signal

groups.name: Output_Interface
groups.description: Parallel output data and completion valid pulse
